channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
item.description: Itaú is rolling out its AI First strategy through the ia.i conversational interface and IARA governance platform, covering about 300,000 customers in Brazil and aiming for 100% of its customer base by end-2026, in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Exciting news: Muse Spark Open (Max) by @AIatMeta is the #1 US open model in the Code Arena: WebDev! With 1511 pts, it’s #13 among open m...
item.description: Meta's Muse Spark Open (Max) scored 1511 on Code Arena: WebDev, taking first among US open models and 13th on the open leaderboard, 156 points above Muse Glimmer at 41st.

item.title: How Anthropic redesigned code review after Claude wrote about 90% of Claude Code's code
item.description: Claude now writes about 90% of Claude Code's code, yet Anthropic's redesign of code review between June and September 2026 more than doubled merged PRs while cutting the revert rate by over 40%, shifting the reading to machines and leaving humans to judge what could go wrong.

item.title: New DeepSeek just dropped. WorkBuddy Intl is updated to the latest too, and it's free through Oct 31. Take it for a spin.
item.description: WorkBuddy Intl has upgraded to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, free through October 31, with DeepSeek claiming stronger performance, faster task completion and shorter outputs across its website, App and API, plus optimizations for DeepSeek Harness, Tencent CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy.

item.title: 卡兹克实测37999元RTX Spark轻薄本：一周实现本地Token自由
item.description: 卡兹克实测37999元RTX Spark轻薄本：一周实现本地Token自由

item.title: Notion: Context for your agents — Switch AI agents without re-explaining your work
item.description: Notion's "Context for your agents" headline promises switching between AI agents without re-explaining your work, yet the page itself shows only a "Performing security verification" CAPTCHA screen and no substantive detail. (Product Hunt)

item.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory — Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
item.description: ai-memory lets Claude Code quit mid-task and Codex resume in the same directory, with 20+ harnesses sharing memory, owner-only handoff claims, and memory stored as git-managed plain Markdown. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Apple’s updated App Store rules go after ‘nudify’ AI apps
item.description: Apple’s App Store rules now explicitly ban nudify apps, including bait-and-switch ones with nudification features, requiring developers to prevent and remove nonconsensual sexualized deepfakes, as San Francisco’s city attorney sought removal of 13 such apps. (The Verge)

item.title: Show HN: Llmspeed – Test local LLM speeds before you buy hardware
item.description: Llmspeed lets you pick a GPU or Mac and a model, then simulates local LLM tokens/sec and time-to-first-token from verified benchmarks sourced from r/LocalLLaMA and localscore.ai, so you can gauge real speed before buying hardware. (llmspeed.dev)

item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017上线，为首个CED架构MoE模型
item.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, the October 17, 2026 snapshot, is the first sparse MoE built on the CED architecture, activating just 8B input and 16B output parameters from a 552B backbone while cutting KV cache to roughly a quarter of the prior generation. (openrouter.ai)

item.title: CrewTower Mod for Claude Code — Talk to Claude Code right from your MacBook notch
item.description: CrewTower is a Mac tool that lets users talk to and control the Claude Code AI coding agent directly from the MacBook notch, eliminating the need to switch windows while coding. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Using Claude to design more efficient quantum circuits
item.description: Claude independently designed eight classes of quantum circuits spanning chemistry, optimization, physics simulation and number theory, with some improving on published best versions by an order of magnitude or more, including FeMoco gate counts dropping from 50 trillion Toffoli gates. (www.anthropic.com)

item.title: You can totally invent Transformers from memory.
item.description: Reframing linear layers, MLPs, and self-attention as distinct memory stores, the article uses interference-to-signal ratio to show that with 64-dimensional keys memory count can rise from about 64 to about 2,700 and then beyond one million. (alexwang.ai)

item.title: DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017
item.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, claims gains in reasoning, coding, agentic tasks and visual benchmarks while cutting task execution time and output length, shipping with encoding.py and the MIT-licensed deepseek-recipe Rust library. (huggingface.co)

item.title: How the Claude Code team does code review
item.description: Claude now writes about 90% of the Claude Code team's code, with merged PRs doubling from June to September and reverts falling over 40%, as the team shifts review left so machines check first and humans focus on high-value issues. (claude.dev)

item.title: Anthropic was assigned the highest-level junk credit rating in June.
item.description: Anthropic was assigned the highest tier of junk credit rating in June, the Financial Times reported on October 16, 2026, a detail illuminating the AI company's standing in credit markets and debt financing. (www.ft.com)

item.title: 90% of U.S. work time is spent on tasks that AI benchmarks fail to adequately cover
item.description: US Benchmark Map maps 29 AI benchmarks onto 923 O*NET occupations and finds only 208 have at least five benchmark prompts, leaving 90% of US work time on poorly covered tasks. (www.mercor.com)

item.title: Show HN: Gemini 4 Argon plays StarCraft
item.description: StarSkirmish Bench v0.2 gives flagship LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta one hour each to write a C++ Protoss bot, yet top-scoring GPT-6 Astra wins only 7% against human-written bots like Stardust. (starskirmish.com)

item.title: FLUX 3 Images Klein
item.description: FLUX 3 Image Klein ships as 5.6B open-weight parameters supporting text-to-image, editing and multi-reference generation from up to 10 images, with an INT8 build running on 8GB VRAM NVIDIA GeForce RTX GPUs via ComfyUI and ranking first in internal evaluations. (bfl.ai)

item.title: Postgres 19 delayed after AI reviewers find more vulnerabilities than humans can fix
item.description: Postgres 19 delayed after AI reviewers find more vulnerabilities than humans can fix (www.theregister.com)
